title: 'Solvency holds at ALL times' Critical Invariant is only eventually-consistent (transiently false by mintDebt)
violatedInvariant: 'Solvency (always): balance == rewardBudget + committedDebt holds at ALL times' — CLAUDE.md Critical Invariants
deviation: Between a config recompute (topUp/setTargetAPY, which do not pull() first) and the next pull(), rewardBudget + committedDebt over-states the on-chain balance by exactly the un-pulled mintDebt. The 'holds at ALL times' wording is strict; actual behaviour is eventually-consistent (strict equality restored on the next _syncBudget). Phantom over-statement is never payable (_safePay gates on real balance).
